text:
Alex Chen: Heads up — after tomorrow's NCCL + driver roll (470.94 -> 520.50) ~10% of west-2 GPU nodes showing missing MIG profiles and intermittent NVLink flaps.
Maya Patel: Seeing same in us-east1. 3 nodes reported profiles gone and device UUIDs remapped. `mig-reconcile` times out on those hosts.
Samir "Sam" Rao: Which reconciliation script are you running? logs?
Maya Patel: `./scripts/mig-reconcile --cluster cluster-prod --dry-run` hangs at "syncing slices".
```
Error: timeout waiting for nv-hostengine response
  at mig-sync.js:112:23
  at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:94:5)
```
Lee Wong: `nvidia-smi mig -L` returns nothing, but `nvidia-smi -q` still enumerates physical GPUs. NVML shows "UUID mismatch" in syslog.
Jo Kim: Any kernel hotpatches? I noticed hosts on west-2 got kernel 6.1.12 pushed last night.
Alex Chen: Installer log shows kernel module built for 6.1.10. Looks like driver install collided with a kernel update -> module ABI mismatch + nvlink reset.
Samir "Sam" Rao: Quick workaround we've used: drain node, restart nvidia services, if that fails schedule a full reboot. Commands we tried:
`systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced`
`modprobe -r nvidia_uvm && modprobe nvidia_uvm`
Maya Patel: Confirmed. 3/8 nodes recovered after reboot. 5 nodes still show UUID drift where device IDs reassign and kube-device-plugin rejects allocs.
Maya Patel: Example: `kubectl describe node gpu-node-12 | grep -A3 'nvidia.com/gpu'` shows stale descriptors referencing old MIG UUIDs.
Lee Wong: I'm prototyping a change to `mig-reconcile` — add `--force-rebuild` that calls `nvidia-smi mig -cgi` to rebuild slice layout. Risk: live workload disruption.
Alex Chen: Proposed runbook:
1) Quarantine affected nodes in fleet (remove from autoscaler / cordon)
2) Off-peak full host reboot, retest `nvidia-smi mig -L`
3) If still bad, rollback driver on a small batch to previous known-good (470.94)
4) Run `mig-reconcile --force-rebuild` and patch kube-device-plugin cache
5) If unresolved, escalate to Nvidia with kernel+driver logs
Jo Kim: Note: west-2 is small capacity for regional customers. We can't mass-quarantine without routing fallback to Dedicated. Ops/Networking — please prep routing policy to steer traffic.
infra-bot: Incident created INC-2026-492. Assigned: eng-infra. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-492
Samir "Sam" Rao: I'll run a canary on 2 staging nodes with kernel 6.1.12 + driver 520.50 and report within 30m.
Maya Patel: Posting quick dmesg grep:
```
[  12.345678] NVRM: GPU at 0000:81:00.0: RmInitAdapter failed! (0x12:0x54:123)
[  12.345689] nvidia: HostKernelApis: module is from the wrong kernel or built for a different kernel
```
Alex Chen: :thumbsup: Keep this thread updated. If rollback is needed, coordinate with releases and CS for affected customers.
